name: Trial of the Celestial Heights
summary: The Storm-Oath Covenant campaign follows Asgardian deities across Valhalla bridge law, Forgotten banner pressure, and Olympian trial conflict as the Gate tries to harvest sworn courage. Full mission-arc recreation pass now rewrites all seven Mythos Gates routes with route-native chapter arcs, mission titles, objectives, dialogue hooks, and mission art prompts.
loreDirectorNotes: Preserves faction separation by presenting allied objectives without implying free faction mixing.
gameplayDirectorNotes: Adds environmental tests: storm lanes, arena platforms, and elite enemies. Current pass targets dungeon-route pacing, one-deity readability, shrine/treasure/boss nodes, and faction-specific hazard language.
artDirectorNotes: Needs Storm-Oath Bridge, Marble Sky Arena, Hrodda, Lyrion, and Forgotten Standard Bearer art.
developmentDirectorNotes: Requires map modifier support before becoming playable.
recommendedNextTask: Tune individual boss mechanics and playable route UI now that every route has rewritten mission arcs.

mobileUe5Architecture.structure: Campaign → Region → Zone → Exploration → Encounter → Tactical Combat → Reward → Next Zone
mobileUe5Architecture.zoneStrategy: large detailed modular zones, not seamless open world and not generic corridors
mobileUe5Architecture.prototypeGate: Do not expand implementation ahead of approved first-zone loop.
